messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "prescribing information contains storage information for different brands while in use"
set: ["prescribing information contains storage information for different brands while in use", "storage once in use varies for different brands", "check the prescribing information", "pharmacist can provide more information about storage", "see disposal information for safe disposal", "different while nursing", "see detailed dosage information for full list", "ask your doctor or pharmacist for more information", "some brands have different recommendations", "access information online at Poison Help", "some brands have different dosage instructions", "visit www.fda.gov/drugdisposal for more information on disposing of unused medicines", "do not use different brands of semaglutide at the same time", "read information every time even if taken before", "check your label for storage instructions", "use different spot on abdomen each time"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
